text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Arrived at the aquarium solo.
Commencing Operation: 'Change of Pace'—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Bourbon! Are you all by yourself~?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Master has duties to attend to,
so I was instructed to refresh myself alone, hence my presence here.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It has been input into me since childhood
that aquariums are an effective means of refreshing one's mind.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Then hey, wanna make the rounds with me for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I was supposed to come with Prez,
but her meeting ran late, so she's still back at the academy~

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I've seen data showing that socializing in groups doubles the effect of refreshing one's mood.
By all means, please do.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"That's the spirit! First up, then...
The main attraction of the aquarium! The dolphin show!"
(Ka-splash!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ah! This movement of the dolphin is—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay, Bourbon~?
Your mind seemed elsewhere halfway through.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Memory restored.
I was recalling words spoken by my father.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Dolphins move in perfect sync with their surroundings.
The propulsion from their fins holds hints for running."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You have conversations like that at an aquarium?
How unusual~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
......No, I guess it's pretty similar for me too.
Most of the time, the Prez is just cracking puns non-stop.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
When I said, "Hey, it's a dolphin show!",
she was just like, "Are there really dol-phins here?"... kind of pun.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone enjoys things their own way!
And we're having fun, so that's what counts!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Because that, too, will become a precious memory.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Operation: "Change of Pace" deemed complete.
Returning to report to Master.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now I want to see the Prez too!
Guess I'll head back to the academy~♪

Having gained fresh insight from taking a breather,
Mihono Bourbon's running had reached a new level of polish!
